# Overview


# Load Required Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)    # Core tidyverse packages
library(readxl)       # read Excel files
library(lme4)         # mixed models
library(emmeans)      # Estimated mean marginal means

```


# Data preparation
## Load dataset
```{r}
# Import dataset
raw_data <- read_excel("soybean_P_response_dataset.xlsx", sheet = "data")

# Inspect structure
#str(raw_data)
```



## Define response (binary)

```{r}
# Sensitivity parameter
#k <- c(0, 0.5, 1)
k <- 1
# Compute control statistics per site
control_stats <- raw_data %>%
  filter(trt_name == "0") %>%
  group_by(loc_num) %>%
  summarise(
    control_mean = mean(yield_mg_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    control_sd   = sd(yield_mg_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Join and define binary response
df <- raw_data %>%
  left_join(control_stats, by = "loc_num") %>%
  mutate(
    threshold = control_mean + k * control_sd,
    response  = ifelse(yield_mg_ha > threshold, 1, 0)
  )

```

## Create predictors
```{r}
df <- df %>%
  filter(trt_name != "0") %>%
  mutate(
    rate = as.numeric(gsub(" .*", "", trt_name)),
    pathway = ifelse(
      grepl("R", trt_name),
      "Residual P (corn)",
      "Direct P (soybean)"
    ),
    pathway = factor(pathway)
  )

# Checks
table(df$response)
table(df$response, df$loc_num)

```

# Model
## Logistic mixed model

```{r}
# logistic mixed model
m_logit <- glmer(
  response ~ rate * pathway + (1 | loc_num),
  family = binomial,
  data = df
)

summary(m_logit)

```

## Predictions
```{r}
pred_df <- emmeans(
  m_logit,
  ~ rate * pathway,
  at = list(rate = c(34, 67, 101, 134)),
  type = "response"
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(
    x = rate,
    predicted = prob,
    conf.low = asymp.LCL,
    conf.high = asymp.UCL,
    group = pathway
  ) %>%
  filter(!(x == 134 & group == "Direct P (soybean)"))

```


## Plot

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(pred_df,
       aes(x = x,
           y = predicted,
           color = group,
           fill = group)) +
  
  # CI ribbon
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
              alpha = 0.25, color = NA) +
  
  # line
  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  
  # points
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "cividis") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "cividis") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(34, 67, 101, 134)) +
  
  labs(
    x = expression(Phosphorus~rate~(kg~P[2]*O[5]~ha^-1)),
    y = "Probability of response",
    color = "",
    fill  = ""
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 2),
    legend.key = element_rect(color = "white"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```
